Name: Rage Engine
Description:
Rage Engine - realistic NPC physics, injuries, gore and AI for Blade & Sorcery: Nomad.
NPCs: real hit physics, euphoria-style pain reactions, bone breaks, broken and hanging jaws, eyes that pop out and blind, teeth that get knocked out, bleeding, bruising, vomiting from gut shots, knockouts, concussions, brain damage, dying moments, surrender and begging. Every NPC has a personality and a weapon proficiency; NPCs pick how to defend (high or low guard, sidesteps, backing off, parry and counter), tire out in long fights, patrol dungeons and go check noises (thrown or breaking objects, faction signals); NPCs taunt you, react when you aim at them, panic when their friends die, and try to put themselves out when set on fire.
Gore: dynamic organs (cut them open and organs spill - or reach in and rip out the heart or spine), heads that turn to goo, lightning scars, burning to ash.
Serums: 13 serums and 20 super serums with powers plus toxin oils and a Serum Lab. In the item book (Potions / Daggers). NPC Spawner, faction noisemakers (Eraden bell, Outlaw coin pouch, Wildfolk rattle, Eye resonance fork) and the Seer's Mirror in Utilities - and everything on the Crystal Hunt shop's shelves.
Maps: Rage Tower, Skybar, Red Room Diner and Rage Yard (sandbox) in the level list, with the wave book. Breakable glass, loose props.
Waves: Rage waves with battle music, including Super Soldier waves.
Settings (Mod Options): Rage / Gore / NPCs / You tabs - style presets (incl. Realism), NPC HP, stay on feet, health bars, wave music, and more. Can run alongside other gore mods.
Author: Rage Engine
